create.name: Marta Metrass
create.bio:
Marta Metrass is a yoga teacher and the creator of Yoga of Emotions, an approach that treats a yoga class as a place to notice and work with feeling as well as posture. She holds a master's degree in dance from a Portuguese university of human kinetics and is registered with Yoga Alliance as an experienced 500-hour teacher and continuing-education provider. She came to yoga after a career in a creative industry, then moved to Thailand with her young family to study and teach full time.

For about seven years she lived in Bali, where she opened a practice space of her own, The Temple of Emotions, before returning to Thailand, which is now home. Each of her classes is built around a theme, combining flowing vinyasa and hatha sequences with breathing, meditation, mantra, chakra work and simple ritual. She offers recorded courses at beginner, intermediate and advanced levels, a membership with a weekly live class on Zoom, pilgrimages and retreats in Asia, and a 200-hour teacher training held in Thailand. She also creates personal ceremonies for life transitions, and has guided practices on Insight Timer and talks in Portuguese and English on her YouTube channel.

courses.title: Yoga of Emotions Online Courses
courses.description: A three-level series of recorded courses, beginner to advanced, that pairs yoga sequences with breath and emotional awareness, each level building on the last. The beginner level is open now with lifetime access; the intermediate and advanced levels are offered on pre-order for 2027.

courses.title: Yoga of Emotions Online Classes Membership
courses.description: A membership built around one live class a week on Zoom, with replays and a library of recorded practices on themes such as the chakras, mantra, the elements, breathwork and yogic philosophy, added to every month.
courses.price: $43 USD per month or $430 USD per year

courses.title: Ma - A Sacred Immersion in Rishikesh & Haridwar
courses.description: A six-night devotional journey in two of India's holy cities on the Ganges, co-led with Nhi Nhi Le. Days combine yoga and meditation with temple visits, the evening Ganga Aarti, kirtan, a tea ceremony and time outdoors.
courses.price: $1,400 USD shared room, $1,600 USD private room (standard price)

courses.title: Yoga of Emotions 200-Hour Teacher Training
courses.description: A 21-day residential training certified by Yoga Alliance, held at a beachfront retreat centre in Thailand, covering vinyasa and hatha, philosophy, meditation, chakras and breath, and how to teach classes shaped around a theme.

free_resources.title: Marta Metrass on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her guided meditations and yoga practices on the Insight Timer app, free to play.
